notes: A 30 gal (114 L), 1.6 running hp belt-drive compressor; the spec chart rates both models 120/240 V, 15/7.5 A, single phase. The parts list shows three alternative motors with their own capacitors, and a valve and a switch only for an SLC1683066 that the chart does not cover, so check the motor nameplate before matching parts.

gaps: No retail brand is printed; the manual is Sanborn Mfg.'s (division of MAT Industries), so the brand is Sanborn and no rebadge is claimed.
The spec chart covers LA1683066 and LC1683066 only; the parts list also gives an SLC1683066-only ASME valve (136-0005) and pressure switch (034-0226), noted in those parts' specs.
Three motors (160-0264, 160-0345, 160-0354) are listed with no mapping to the models.

The capacitor table has two rows for motor 160-0264 (checked on the rendered page) and they are given as alternatives; no uF or voltage rating is printed, so none is given, and the bracketed codes are copied as printed.

The chart's voltage, amps and phase (120/240-15/7.5-1) are the model's rating, not stated for the motor, so no v or a is set on the motor; page 11 mentions a 115/230 volt dual-voltage motor on some models only.
The chart prints the kick-in and kick-out pressures with a bar value and no psi label, so none is written.
The gauges (parts list items 1 and 5) are listed by size and connection only (255# and 300#); which is the tank gauge is not said.
The parts list gives no function for the ASME valve (item 4), so none is claimed.
No production years are given; the manual is Revision L dated 6/6/18, copyright 2015 to 2018.
method: Sanborn Mfg. Operator-Parts Manual 200-2901, Revision L (6/6/18), single stage belt drive electric air compressors; PDF on Home Depot's product-document server, read as text with the research tool.

Pages used: 1 spec chart, 11 motor reset switch, 23 valves, gauges, switch, regulator and coupler, 25 belt, pulleys, motors, capacitors, tank and cord, 26 pump specification box, 27 pump parts; pages 1, 23, 25 and 26 were rendered and read as images.
Retail listings under other brand names for the same model numbers came up in search but were not opened (Ferguson returned 403, Tractor Supply timed out).
No other document for this model number was opened.

comps.spec: Pump assembly 040-0469 (parts list item 38): two cylinders (item 14, qty 2), two piston assemblies (item 12, qty 2), two valve plates (item 7, qty 2), crankshaft 053-0107 (item 25), oil fill plug (item 20) and oil sight glass (item 21)
Synthetic blend, non-detergent air compressor oil; pump oil capacity 11.35 oz (336 ml)
Electric motor, 1.6 running hp for both models (spec chart)
Motor options in the parts list: 160-0264 (BT198E.00-M), 160-0345 (BT198K18.00M) and 160-0354 (56S34D1.8M), each with its own capacitor set
Tank assembly 153-0153 (parts list item 22), which includes wheels, hubcaps, pads, bushing, petcock, pipe plug, O-rings, warning label and handle grips (items 23 to 30 and 34)
Pressure switch settings in the spec chart: LA1683066 kick-in 125 (8.62 bar) and kick-out 155 (10.69 bar); LC1683066 kick-in 105 (7.23 bar) and kick-out 135 (9.30 bar)
Pressure switch part 034-0184 (parts list item 6), includes bleeder valve, strain relief and screw (items 7 to 9); SLC1683066-only alternative 034-0226
ASME valve 136-0077 (parts list item 4); alternative 136-0005 listed for model SLC1683066 only
Bleeder valve 136-0090 (parts list item 7), part of the pressure switch assembly
Check valve 1/2 in x 3/8 in, part 031-0037 (parts list item 15)
Petcock 072-0006 (parts list item 27), in the tank assembly
Air pressure regulator 019-0167 (parts list item 2)
Gauge listed as 300#, 1/4 in bottom connection, part 032-0025 (parts list item 5)
Gauge listed as 255#, 1/8 in back connection, part 032-0056 (parts list item 1)
Quick connect coupler 036-0031 (parts list item 10)
V-belt 4L-460, part 007-0010 (parts list item 3)
Motor pulley 006-0018 (parts list item 6), held by two 5/16-18 setscrews (item 5)
Pump flywheel, A-groove, part 044-0082 (parts list item 31)
Run capacitor for motor 160-0264: 166-0181 (0901040) in the capacitor table's first row and 166-0196 (CBB60) in a second row, as alternatives; run capacitor cover 166-0182 (0104045) in both rows

Start capacitor for motor 160-0264: 166-0180 (0901080) in the capacitor table's first row and 166-0195 (D250400NNCA) in a second row, as alternatives; start capacitor cover 166-0182 (0104045) in both rows
Motor reset switch: after an overload shutdown the manual says to wait 10 to 15 minutes while the motor cools, then press the switch to restart
Power cord 026-0030 (parts list item 32)
Pump ball bearings 204 (part 051-0103, item 24) and 205 (part 051-0104, item 26), one of each
